source_policy_decisions.decision: Separate parimāṇa, an overall quantity, from the measure standard licensed in PG785. The relative and correlative have separate bases. The nested example is credited as an interface only.
Admit only the Vedic personal-pronoun resemblance extension here. Resolve the genitives from the clauses and the commentary, and the nominative from the Pada.
Store both arguments for admitting vatup on kim/idam. Exclude the altar’s iyāt from nominal evidence.
Retain both numerical options, the independent relative and the later change from how many to which. A general value question does not license the count suffix.
The Vedic i-final plural adds one reading to PG8’s existing position. Sāyaṇa’s explanatory smaḥ and unchanged lexical ownership earn zero additional positions.
